text:
jamie: small copy review — confirmation modal when a user cancels an ongoing KV cache preload job. product wants to be explicit about cost and partial benefits. current: `Cancel preload? You may lose partial performance gains.`

lee: feels a bit vague. users need to know if already-applied cache remains. maybe: `Cancel preload? Any entries added so far will remain, but the cache may be less effective.`

hannah: accessibility: use plain language and avoid passive voice. also avoid 'may' a lot. what about: `Cancel preload? Entries already cached will stay, but stopping the preload may reduce performance improvements.`

jamie: alternative shorter: `Stop preloading? Cached items so far will remain. Stopping may slow responses until the cache refills.`

lee: i like the shorter one. tweak CTA buttons: primary should be `Stop preload` (destructive-ish) and secondary `Keep running`. that phrasing clarifies the action.

hannah: agree on buttons. tiny nit: add a small inline help link to docs in the modal: `Learn more about preloads` that opens docs. aria-label for the link: `Learn more about cache preloads (opens in new tab)`

jamie: final copy i'll push: Modal title: `Stop cache preload?` Body: `Cached entries added so far will stay. Stopping may slow responses until the cache refills.` Buttons: primary: `Stop preload` (primary, focused), secondary: `Keep running`, tertiary: `Cancel` (if we show a tertiary) Link: `Learn more about cache preloads` (opens new tab).

design-bot: created figma frame "Preload cancel modal copy" at 1776010050.

lee: QA/engineering ask: include telemetry event `kv_cache.preload_cancel.confirmed` and show toast copy after action: `Preload stopped. Existing cache entries remain.`

hannah: a11y checklist: focus trap in modal, primary button focused, descriptive aria-labelledby + aria-describedby linking body, link has rel="noopener" and opens in new tab. color contrast OK for primary button text.

jamie: thanks all — i'll update the tokens and add the telemetry. will post final strings here when pushed.
